outcome: Angiographic findings (uterine artery obliteration, recanalization, patent arteries, collateral vessel embolization)
cohort: The study included 13 patients who underwent repeat UAE for recurrent PPH after subsequent delivery, having a history of prior UAE for PPH.
finding: UAE with gelatin sponge slurry frequently causes permanent uterine artery obliteration, and in cases of recurrent PPH in subsequent pregnancy, repeat UAE may be less likely to achieve hemostasis (69.2%).
